# The Wooden Bird

> Hand-carved decorative duck decoys and waterfowl by Rick Mignano, an award-winning carver in North Barrington, Illinois (near Chicago). Each bird is carved from tupelo or basswood, textured, wood-burned and painted by hand in acrylics, and signed. Rick's birds have won more than 50 ribbons, including Best of Show at the Louisiana, Wisconsin and Ohio waterfowl shows and 2nd place at the Ward World Championship.

## Commissions
- Most birds are commissions. A 50% deposit reserves a place; Rick sends an estimated completion date and emails progress photos every couple of days.
- Typical price for a full-detail bird: $1,500 to $2,500. Duck Shop pieces: $695 to $795.
- Typical wait: about six months. Rick carves one or two birds a month. Each takes 50 to 80 hours.
- Birds ship insured anywhere in the US. Commission gift certificates are available.
